scope: Targeted primary-source antecedent review, not an exhaustive novelty search, scientific evaluation or legal/patent opinion.

sources.title: Shadow-Based Matching for Precise and Robust Absolute Self-Localization during Lunar Landings
sources.authors: Hannah Kaufmann; Martin Lingenauber; Tim Bodenmüller; Michael Suppa
sources.access: Official DLR institutional abstract; full PDF restricted.
sources.actually_did: Matched segmented shadow configurations to DEM-rendered references using known Sun position, a shadow-neighborhood descriptor and RANSAC.
sources.not_established: Does not establish the same unknown-Sun sparse correspondence/pose inference mechanism.

sources.title: Shadow Detection and Sun Direction in Photo Collections
sources.authors: Scott Wehrwein; Kavita Bala; Noah Snavely
sources.access: Official author project page inspected; 12MB PDF exceeded web-tool content limit.
sources.actually_did: Used illumination ratios across reconstructed photo collections to label shadows at 3D points and estimate Sun directions.
sources.not_established: Not evidence of the same two-image native-patch matcher or its pose accuracy.

sources.title: SUNDIAL: 3D Satellite Understanding through Direct, Ambient, and Complex Lighting Decomposition
sources.authors: Nikhil Behari; Akshat Dave; Kushagra Tiwary; William Yang; Ramesh Raskar
sources.venue: arXiv v1, 24 December 2023; CVPR EarthVision workshop version 2024
sources.access: Primary full text inspected, especially Sections 3.4 and 4.3.
sources.actually_did: Jointly trained satellite-scene geometry and image-dependent Sun directions with secondary shadow rays and illumination decomposition.
sources.not_established: Per-scene neural reconstruction does not demonstrate the same fixed-map, sparse PnP inference task.

sources.title: Illumination Invariant Image Matching for Lunar TRN
sources.authors: Noah Rothenberger; Georgios Georgakis; Yang Cheng; Adnan Ansar
sources.access: Publisher search abstract and author summary inspected; full AIAA page/PDF inaccessible (403).
sources.actually_did: Introduced correlation-based LIMA and learned illumination-invariant features, with synthetic and real experiments.
sources.not_established: Full algorithm details and numerical tables were not verified in this review.

sources.title: Stitching Illumination-Matched Maps: A LIMA-Based Pipeline for Robust Reference Map Generation
sources.authors: Noah Rothenberger; Yang Cheng; Adnan Ansar; Yumi Iwashita
sources.access: Author research summary inspected; linked AIAA full page inaccessible (403).
sources.actually_did: Reports synthesizing target-lighting reference maps from images acquired at different Sun angles.
sources.not_established: Do not infer an identical implementation or compare inaccessible numerical results.

sources.title: Precomputed Radiance Transfer for Real-Time Rendering in Dynamic, Low-Frequency Lighting Environments
sources.authors: Peter-Pike Sloan; Jan Kautz; John Snyder
sources.access: Official Microsoft Research publication abstract inspected.
sources.actually_did: Represented precomputed surface light-transfer functions and lighting using low-order SH for efficient rendering including shadowing and interreflection.
sources.not_established: SH transfer representation is not new; this work is not a learned descriptor-response matcher.

sources.title: Neural Radiance Transfer Fields for Relightable Novel-view Synthesis with Global Illumination
sources.authors: Linjie Lyu; Ayush Tewari; Thomas Leimkühler; Marc Habermann; Christian Theobalt
sources.access: Primary full paper Section 3, author project and official repository inspected.
sources.actually_did: Learned radiance transfer conditioned on position, normal and incoming/outgoing directions, using synthetic one-light-at-a-time and real-image supervision.
sources.not_established: Its outputs are scene radiance, not frozen local matching descriptors or lunar camera localization.

sources.title: Decomposing NeRF for Editing via Feature Field Distillation
sources.authors: Sosuke Kobayashi; Eiichi Matsumoto; Vincent Sitzmann
sources.access: Official author project abstract and method summary inspected.
sources.actually_did: Distilled pretrained 2D image features such as LSeg or DINO into a 3D feature field for semantic decomposition and editing.
sources.not_established: Feature-field distillation is established; this source does not demonstrate the same Sun-conditioned matching-feature targets.

sources.title: Lambertian Reflectance and Linear Subspaces
sources.access: Primary full paper inspected; assumptions and exclusion of cast shadows explicit in Sections 2–3.
sources.actually_did: Derived a low-dimensional SH approximation for convex Lambertian reflectance under distant illumination, including attached shadows but excluding cast shadows.
sources.not_established: Does not guarantee a finite SH model for nonconvex lunar cast shadows or normalized nonlinear descriptor responses.

sources.title: Active Matching
sources.actually_did: Used dynamic mixture-of-Gaussians hypotheses and expected Shannon information gain to choose sequential feature searches and update global consensus before more image processing.
sources.not_established: Deferred image processing, multiple-hypothesis search and informative feature acquisition cannot be claimed as new general ideas.

sources.title: Selecting Landmarks for Localization in Natural Terrain
sources.actually_did: Selected natural-terrain localization landmarks by minimizing predicted localization uncertainty under a sensor error model.
sources.not_established: Uncertainty-aware selection in terrain localization predates this implementation.

sources.title: Terrain Relative Navigation for Lunar Polar Roving: Exploiting Geometry, Shadows, and Planning
sources.access: Official CMU institutional abstract inspected; linked Dropbox thesis unavailable.
sources.actually_did: Combined terrain registration under map/sensor uncertainty, shadow features, localization-uncertainty prediction and information-aware belief-space planning for lunar polar roving.
sources.not_established: Not evidence of the same within-image sparse patch-budget policy or its efficiency.

modules.implemented: Sparse candidates and camera-pose hypotheses share one query Sun; reference-map rays score soft query shadow observations during assignment/refinement.
modules.candidate_difference_our_inference: The fixed-map, two-image sparse matcher couples one Sun across all candidate assignments and pose updates at inference, rather than assuming Sun known or learning a scene reconstruction.
modules.novelty_status: Unproven; broad joint illumination/geometry reasoning and lunar shadow localization are established.
decisive_tests: Shared vs solar-off vs independent-Sun with identical candidates and pose budget.
Estimated-Sun vs supplied-Sun information tracks; report Sun errors and informative-anchor support separately.
Camera-pose gains under lighting/viewpoint change, not just improved shadow agreement.

modules.implemented: Canonical 33px patches produce 36 real-SH coefficient vectors for a 32D frozen-teacher descriptor response, conditioned on observed Sun, normal and view; total model remains below100k.
modules.candidate_difference_our_inference: A compact patch-conditioned field predicts counterfactual local matching descriptors, rather than RGB radiance or semantic NeRF features, and is evaluated through correspondence/absolute camera pose.
modules.novelty_status: Unproven; SH response bases, learned directional transfer, feature distillation and illumination-robust descriptors are established.
decisive_tests: Capacity/data/training-budget matched pooled control and frozen native refinement.
Held-out physical illumination and terrain groups; report actual response use.
Failure/conditioning analysis near hard shadow transitions; no full-sphere response claim from the limited training lighting domain.

modules.implemented: Native patch measurements are selected sequentially from pose/Sun hypotheses using interval separation across0,±5,±10,±20m height variants; extraction is deferred until selection.
modules.candidate_difference_our_inference: A particular Sun/pose disagreement heuristic under specified height perturbations is inserted into a compact lunar matching search with bounded native measurement counts.
modules.novelty_status: Unproven; active matching and uncertainty-aware terrain landmark selection already exist.
implementation_cautions: The score is weighted interval separation, not expected Shannon information gain.
Its channels currently contain projected geometry, physical shadow states and a geometry-consistency proxy—not predicted learned-descriptor observations.
Global height shifts do not cover arbitrary map errors; no-live-hypothesis fallback can be uniform.
decisive_tests: Uniform, strongest-appearance and geometry-only controls at32/64/128 measurements.
Complete timing including hypothesis management, physical lookups and cold reference preparation.
Pose gains under declared height perturbations; log nonuniform decisions and valid response usage.

global_caveats: No absence-of-prior-art or first-method claim follows from this review.
Task/information/compute differences preclude a numerical SOTA ranking from these sources.
No model run, optimization, image annotation, root edit, email, submission or publication performed.
